import pandas as pd

# Paths to source files
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_40/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_40/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_40/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_40/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_40/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_40/training_6.csv"
]

# Read all source tables with the same schema and union them
dfs = []
for file in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    # Select only the columns needed for the target
    df_subset = df[['state', 'vet_pop', 'vet_males', 'vet_females']]
    dfs.append(df_subset)

# UNION operation: concatenate all dataframes
union_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# According to the operation history, the JOIN with Source6_40_2 results in empty dataframe,
# so it does not contribute to the final output and can be ignored.

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
union_df['state'] = union_df['state'].astype(str)
union_df['vet_pop'] = union_df['vet_pop'].astype(float)
union_df['vet_males'] = union_df['vet_males'].astype(float)
union_df['vet_females'] = union_df['vet_females'].astype(float)

# Save the final target table
union_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_40/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
